MS Dhoni Retires from IPL, Appointed Chennai Super Kings Mentor

Mahendra Singh Dhoni has retired from the Indian Premier League (IPL), with Chennai Super Kings (CSK) announcing his appointment as team mentor for the 2027 season. Dhoni's playing career concluded in the IPL, and he will now guide the team in a mentoring capacity. He had previously promised his final T20 game would be at the MAC Stadium. One report mentioned Dhoni moving CSK to a different hotel overnight over a biryani issue.
